## Stress test (development_medium, fixed plans)

30 scenarios per setting, seed 20261008. Travel time on arc (i, j) is multiplied by a day-level congestion factor (lognormal) times road-level noise (lognormal, mean 1, CV 0.1).

Sensitivity plan `lns_buffer15`: the LNS planned on travel times x 1.15 (a congestion buffer), then executed on the scenario times like the other plans. Its cost on the true travel times:

| plan | nominal_total_travel_time | vehicles_used | feasible_on_true_times |
|---|---|---|---|
| lns planned with travel x 1.15 | 1,046.69 | 8 | True |

### base (day factor mean 1.0, CV 0.2)

| method | travel_mean | travel_p90 | vehicles_mean | vehicles_p90 | scenarios_with_violation | late_service_starts_total | late_returns_total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| lns | 1,125.71 | 1,402.86 | 8.00 | 8.00 | 10 | 19 | 1 |
| lns_buffer15 | 1,130.57 | 1,420.23 | 8.00 | 8.00 | 10 | 19 | 4 |
| rule | 1,819.31 | 2,267.05 | 11.00 | 11.00 | 11 | 28 | 14 |

### Uniform slowdown tolerance

Every travel time multiplied by the same factor (steps of 0.01); the factor at which each fixed plan first has a late service start or a late return:

| plan | first_violation_at_uniform_slowdown |
|---|---|
| rule | 1.16 |
| lns | 1.26 |

## Route crossings (maps in results/maps/, every crossing in crossings.csv)

Travel times equal the straight-line distance between the plotted coordinates, so these are real crossings. For each crossing inside a route, the 2-opt reversal that removes it was tested: `within_route_uncross_feasible` counts the ones that could be removed without breaking a constraint.

| instance | method | within_a_route | between_vehicles | within_route_uncross_feasible |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| hand_checkable | rule | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| hand_checkable | lns | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| development_small | rule | 1 | 8 | 1 |
| development_small | lns | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| development_medium | rule | 0 | 70 | 0 |
| development_medium | lns | 4 | 12 | 0 |
| development_large | rule | 8 | 257 | 4 |
| development_large | lns | 10 | 50 | 0 |
